layouts.name: LivePreviewVisual_WindowData
layouts.notes: 28000.1/3231: CollectWindows stores CWindowData in each 40-byte record; ClearAnimatedVisuals independently follows that pointer to stop the window animation.

layouts.name: LivePreviewVisual_GlassClone
layouts.notes: 28000.1/3231: ClearAnimatedVisuals releases and zeros the clone at +16 independently of the normal clone at +8. Cross-check the 40-byte records initialized by CollectWindows and walked by FadeOutToGlass.

layouts.name: LivePreviewResource_NormalVisual
layouts.notes: 28000.1/3231: UpdateResourcesForMonitor updates the normal rectangle visual; resource copy/destruction retain/release and detach the same pointer.

layouts.name: LivePreviewResource_NormalBrush
layouts.notes: 28000.1/3231: UpdateResourcesForMonitor uses this CVisualBrush for the normal capture; the resource copy constructor and destructor call the matching brush routines on the same subobject.

layouts.name: LivePreviewResource_GlassVisual
layouts.notes: 28000.1/3231: UpdateResourcesForMonitor updates the glass rectangle visual; resource copy/destruction retain/release and detach the same pointer.

layouts.name: LivePreviewResource_GlassBrush
layouts.notes: 28000.1/3231: UpdateResourcesForMonitor uses this CVisualBrush for the glass capture; the resource copy constructor and destructor call the matching brush routines on the same subobject.

layouts.name: LivePreviewResource_GlassRect
layouts.notes: 28000.1/3231: UpdateResourcesForMonitorHelper unions eligible glass window rectangles into this RECT. UpdateResourcesForMonitor consumes it for the glass visual and capture; the copy constructor copies it independently from the normal rectangle.

layouts.name: LivePreviewResource_MonitorRect
layouts.notes: 28000.1/3231: s_UpdateResourcesForMonitor copies the monitor rectangle into this RECT before updating resources. UpdateResourcesForMonitorHelper independently intersects each window rectangle with it.
